name: Hit
description: A yellow-and-red jagged burst. The standard hit.

name: Slash
description: Three sharp slashes with blue shadows and thick ink lines.

name: Critical
description: A big red-and-yellow shockwave. A powerful hit.

name: Thrust
description: A thin, sharp impact piercing one point. For thrusts, thrown daggers and piercing shots.

name: Shot
description: A star-shaped flash of a bursting bullet. For magic guns, rapid fire and scattershot.

name: Magic
description: A flash of purple and white magic. For holy light, magic bullets, curse waves and more.

name: Guard
description: A blue barrier absorbs the impact. For guarding, protective blessings and parries.

name: Armor Break
description: Armor cracks and shards scatter. For running out of durability or breaking.

name: Repair
description: Blue shards gather to repair armor. For restoring durability.

name: Heal
description: Soft green light rises. For restoring HP and healing potions.

name: Regen
description: Fresh green light circles around. For healing over time and regeneration.

name: Purify
description: Platinum light sweeps away purple grime. For curing poison and status ailments.

name: Revive
description: Platinum light surges upward. For the moment a fallen ally gets back up.

name: Poison
description: Purple poison clings on. For inflicting poison and poison damage.

name: Bind
description: Purple chains tighten. For binding and stun effects.

name: Charge
description: Red and yellow power wells up. For focusing and attack boosts.
